title: Machine-learning models guide design of two vitrimers
summary: An ensemble trained on molecular-dynamics data predicted glass-transition temperatures and screened candidates. The primary preprint reports two synthesized vitrimers with higher measured glass-transition temperatures than the compared bifunctional transesterification vitrimers and demonstrates healability. This is a bounded laboratory comparison, not proof of broad industrial recyclability or lifetime.
ai_technology: Ensemble machine-learning models trained on molecular-dynamics data

evidence.tested: Two nominated vitrimers were synthesized and measured; the paper reports higher Tg than the selected comparator set.
evidence.unknown: Exact composition novelty, healing conditions and independent replication not established.
evidence.ai_role: Molecular-dynamics-informed ML predicted Tg and ranked candidate chemistries for synthesis and measurement.

source_review.scope: Primary source checked for identity, publication date, AI workflow and the bounded experimental result stated.
